notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Started on Hosted API to validate functional fit (in-product assistant + doc search + support triage). Trial produced clear performance and token telemetry — team now evaluating move to Dedicated for predictable latency & unit economics.

Hosted API trial results (observed):
- Average daily QPS (staging): 12 QPS (business hours), baseline weekend 4 QPS
- Peak observed during 48h spike test: 58 QPS (5-minute rolling peak), sustained peak windows ~40 QPS for ~10 minutes
- Concurrency estimate from trial: ~22 concurrent chat sessions (avg 1.8 streams per session), peak concurrency observed ~46 during stress test
- Token mix (trial averages): system/prompt ~120 tokens/request, user prompt ~95 tokens, model response ~360 tokens — average roundtrip ~575 tokens
- Streaming usage: ~35% of calls use streaming for progressive UI; embedding calls are ~12% of API traffic (for search indexing and rerank)
- Latency targets: stated by Head of Product "P50 < 200ms, P90 < 600ms for chat flows" — currently P50 ~140ms, P95 ~520ms on Hosted API (good signal)

Dedicated sizing ask (what Luminary needs from Redwood):
- Recommended committed QPS targets and flavoring: baseline commit for steady-state 15 QPS, buffer for bursts to 80 QPS during campaigns
- Concurrency sizing: plan for sustained concurrency 40 with headroom to 100 for short bursts (marketing promos)
- Token throughput planning: typical hour peak tokens/sec estimated at 80k tokens/sec across cluster during peak; requests skewed toward longer responses (avg 350 tokens)
- Cost forecast ask: per-token committed pricing tiers vs burst add-ons; approximate committed monthly spend target they expect to budget: $10k–$20k/mo initially, scale to $25k–$40k/mo as usage grows

POC & evaluation notes:
- POC Goals: validate latency SLOs, confirm KV/prefix caching benefits for repeated queries, validate model quantization/variant tradeoffs on cost and quality, test autoscaling behavior under spike patterns
- Tests run: A/B prompt sets (latency vs quality), canary with smaller Dedicated pool during trial, end-to-end telemetry hooked into their observability (DataDog)
- Quality constraints: they will not accept >5% quality regressions vs Hosted baseline. Redwood Optimize suggestions were helpful to reduce token usage by ~12% during pilot

Security / compliance:
- Must pass internal security questionnaire (sent 2026-02-18). Primary asks: SOC2 type II evidence, SSO/SAML integration, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for customer keys, data residency controls for EU/NA split (they have EU customers).
- Procurement timeline: legal + procurement expect final contract signoff by end of Q2 (2026-06).

Stakeholder quotes & color:
- Head of Product (Maya Chen): "We like the Hosted experience — predictability of latency matters more than absolute lowest cost right now."
- CTO (Rajan Patel): "We need a clear capacity plan. If you can show concrete QPS->GPU mapping and cost buckets we'll move faster."
- Security Lead (Anika Singh): "Primary blocker is KMS integration and audit retention policy — send demo of audit exports."

Next steps (short):
- AE/SE to deliver Dedicated sizing worksheet and two-tier committed proposal by 2026-03-03 (assigned: Diego Ramos)
- Luminary to complete and return security questionnaire by 2026-03-05
- Schedule procurement + legal sync week of 2026-03-15 to align SOW and payment terms
- Run one focused spike test on Dedicated trial (canary) to validate autoscaling + cold-start behavior (target date: 2026-03-20)

Files & references: pricing deck and security FAQ uploaded to shared Drive links (see linked_drive_docs). Fireflies recordings for 2026-01-12 demo and 2026-02-18 security call available for playback.

POC success criteria (their words):
- Consistent P50 <200ms and P95 <700ms under production-like traffic
- Cost per active-user below threshold agreed in term sheet
- Security checklist approved by InfoSec (KMS + audit logs + SSO)

Sales notes (internal):
- Good fit for Dedicated upsell: mid-market, predictable growth, product-led usage spikes. Emphasize batching/cache suggestions from Optimize and show historic RL examples of cost savings with prefix caching.
- Upside: if procurement ok, opportunity to expand to Private (VPC) deployment for EU-residency after initial Dedicated rollout.
- Risks: procurement delay, potential push to competitor if pricing not competitive for committed tiers.
